in_sanskrit.name: Bunu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessed, Fortunate
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bunu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhu’ meaning ‘to exist’, ‘bhu-nu’ can be translated to ‘she who exists’. In Hindu mythology, Bunu is a name associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity.
